subject: Invoice originator & payment routing — finalizing delivery and VAT evidence
messages:
From: Brightline AP <ap@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: New account setup — invoice delivery / VAT evidence preferences

Hi Irene / Karthik,

We're getting set up on our side for Redwood invoices and want to confirm a few things before go-live on Monday:

- Who will be the "invoice originator" on your side (i.e., the sender name/email that shows on the invoice)? Our AP system uses that to map incoming PDFs.
- Do you support e-invoice portal delivery (SFTP/API) or do you primarily email PDFs? We can accept either but need to know SLA for manual pickup vs automated push.
- VAT evidence / tax certificates: can you send EU VAT registration and a point-of-sale summary with the invoice, or do we need a separate portal link?
- Preferred remittance details for bank transfer (we'll need exact beneficiary and account).

I've attached a short spreadsheet with our default AP mappings and a sample invoice we received in a pilot.

Thanks — can you confirm by EOD today? We're trying to lock mapping to avoid failed imports.

--
Samantha Lee
AP Manager, Brightline Health
ap@brightlinehealth.com
Attachments: Brightline_AP_Preferences.xlsx, sample_invoice.pdf

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Brightline AP <ap@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 12:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: New account setup — invoice delivery / VAT evidence preferences

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear sheet. Quick answers and proposal below:

1) Invoice originator: invoices will be generated by finance@redwood-invoice.com (PDF) and the PDF meta will show "Redwood Inference / Billing". If you prefer a different sender string for mapping, let me know and we can set the envelope From to billing@redwood.com.

2) Delivery options: we support both modes:
   - Preferred: automated SFTP push (we can push a zipped daily bundle + individual PDF for immediate imports). This eliminates manual steps on your side.
   - Fallback: single-PDF email to the billing inbox. If you choose email, please confirm exact address to whitelist.

3) VAT evidence: for EU customers we attach VAT registration in the invoice bundle and include a CSV summary of tax lines. For US customers we include a tax flag and can attach W-9 or exemption docs on request. We can also provide a static Drive URL for longer retention if you need.

4) Remittance: we'll provide our bank account via a secure DocuSign envelope once you confirm channel (portal vs email) for invoice delivery.

Proposal / ask: If you can confirm SFTP endpoint details, we will schedule the first push for Fri 2027-03-05. If you prefer email delivery, confirm the exact recipient and whether you want a daily aggregate or per-invoice email.

I'm copying Karthik to confirm tax handling and the DocuSign step for remit info.

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199
Attachments: none

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Brightline AP <ap@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 12:36:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: New account setup — invoice delivery / VAT evidence preferences

Thanks Samantha / Irene — a couple of clarifications on tax and payment rails:

- For Brightline's US entity: we'll mark invoices as zero-rated where applicable and include a W-9 PDF in the bundle so your AP team has evidentiary docs for record.
- For EU customers (if you have EU subsidiaries): we can include the VAT registration number on the invoice header and a CSV of tax breakdown.
- SEPA vs Wire: Redwood's preferred is ACH for US, SEPA for Euro-area. If you need wire transfer (non-ACH), there may be a one-time bank fee — we'll surface that in the remittance DocuSign.

Operational note: If you pick SFTP, please confirm expected filename pattern (we will default to YYYYMMDD_Redwood_Invoice_<invoiceid>.pdf). If you pick email, we'll send per-invoice emails and a daily digest to the address you provide.

Cc'ing Irene so Finance can generate the secure remit envelope after you confirm the channel.

-Karthik
Finance Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Brightline AP <ap@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Tan <lisa.tan@brightlinehealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 18:07:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: New account setup — invoice delivery / VAT evidence preferences

Thanks Irene / Karthik — we've reviewed internally and will take SFTP as the primary channel. Details below:

- SFTP endpoint: sftp.brightline-ap.example.com (we will send host key separately)
- Filename mapping: YYYYMMDD_Redwood_Invoice_<invoiceid>.pdf (per-invoice files)
- Also request: daily aggregated CSV with tax lines (we will ingest into our tax reconciliation table)
- Email copies: please send a blind-copy daily digest to finance@brightline.com (used for our ticketing).
- Remittance: we'll wait for the DocuSign envelope to populate the beneficiary details and will complete bank verification before first payment.

Attachments: Invoice_202703-BH.pdf, Signed-MSA-page3.pdf

One quick ask — can you surface invoice unique id in the first 40 characters of the PDF filename? It helps our importer.

If you confirm we will schedule our importer to accept the first push on Fri 2027-03-05 and toggle to live on Monday 2027-03-08.

Best,
Samantha Lee
AP Manager, Brightline Health
ap@brightlinehealth.com
